panelSubtitle: Pick a CLI first, then manage its Provider, MCP, and Skill launch combination

ssh.mcp: Sessions in this workspace launch over SSH by default. SSH sessions get no MCP at all (not even shared MCP or ccpanes). For the full setup, add the machine under Devices so its own CC-Panes starts the sessions.
ssh.skills: Sessions in this workspace launch over SSH by default. Workspace skills are not mounted into SSH sessions. Add the machine under Devices for the full setup.

wsl.mcp: Sessions in this workspace launch on WSL by default. HTTP-type MCP servers in this layer are injected; stdio entries (started via command) are host commands and cannot run inside WSL — move them to a shared service (HTTP bridge) if needed.

systemDefaultDescription: No Provider injected; respects the CLI's own config, CC Switch live config, and your environment. CC-Panes only adds its own MCP and Skill capabilities.
workspaceListHint: Select a workspace to see the profile it uses for {{tool}}
listScopeWorkspace: Showing only {{name}} bindings and the current default
listScopeAll: Launch profiles available to all workspaces
listEmptyWorkspace: This workspace has no custom launch profile bound yet. Clicking “Add” creates one and binds it to the current workspace.
systemDefaultDetail: The {{tool}} system default is the launch baseline. No Provider is injected; MCP and Skill defaults can be saved for the current environment.
profileDetail: A launch profile combines Provider, MCP, and Skill for a single launch. It can be bound to a workspace or set as the current CLI's default.
sectionBasicDesc: Set an alias, restrict the applicable CLI, and choose the Provider to inject explicitly.
kimiNativeHint: Uses Kimi Code's own login and config.toml; no KIMI_MODEL_* variables are injected at launch.
kimiManagedHint: Explicit Kimi Providers don't fully support model config yet; Provider selection is disabled.
accountLocalOnlyFallback: This login only works on this machine; WSL / SSH launches fall back to the provider's default account.
piNativeAuthHint: Native values use Pi's auth.json and settings. Entering either uses Pi-native auth instead of a CC-Panes Provider.
piProjectTrustHint: Project trust only controls project resources. It does not enable YOLO or bypass permission checks.
piRpcUnavailable: This Pi adapter does not expose RPC. Use the interactive terminal transport.
piSshRuntimeUnsupported: Pi launch profiles support local and WSL runtimes only.
ompSshRuntimeUnsupported: Oh My Pi launch profiles support local and WSL runtimes only.
jcodeSshRuntimeUnsupported: Jcode launch profiles support local and WSL runtimes only.
kiroSshRuntimeUnsupported: Kiro CLI launch profiles support local and WSL runtimes only.
fxSshRuntimeUnsupported: fx launch profiles support local and WSL runtimes only.
museSshRuntimeUnsupported: Muse Code launch profiles support local and WSL runtimes only.
sectionPermDesc: Set the CLI permission policy for this launch profile.
yoloDesc: Appends CLI bypass flags for this launch only; nothing is written to your Claude/Codex config.
yoloConfirmBody: This makes the CLI launched by this profile skip permission / sandbox checks (Claude: --dangerously-skip-permissions, Codex: bypass approvals and sandbox), which may run dangerous commands without confirmation. Only enable this when you fully trust the workspace.
yoloFootnote: Claude uses skip permissions; Codex uses bypass approvals and sandbox. Other CLIs save this flag but no unknown flags are appended.
sectionPreviewDesc: Resolve the final launch result for the selected workspace.
previewAfterSave: The resolved result appears after saving this launch profile.
previewCreateWorkspaceHint: Create or select a workspace to preview project Skills.
previewSelectWorkspaceHint: Select a workspace on the left to resolve project Skills for it.

sectionMcpDesc: Set the MCP combination injected when this profile launches.
mcpUnsupportedHint: This CLI cannot receive MCP servers. The saved MCP policy is kept but will not be injected.
mcpDisabledHint: This profile won't inject CC-Panes MCP or shared MCP.
mcpCustomHint: Custom mode injects only the shared MCP selected below.
mcpDefaultHint: The default set uses CC-Panes MCP and enables shared MCP not excluded from the library.
ccpanesMcpDesc: Injects CC-Panes session, dispatch, and orchestration tools (core surface). Admin work goes through cc-panes-ctl.
sharedMcpServiceDesc: Reuse configured MCP from the shared library.
useMcpHubDesc: Shared MCP servers are no longer injected one by one; agents use search_tools / call_tool on demand. Local Claude Code / Codex only for now.
sharedMcpEmpty: The shared library is empty. Add or import via “Manage shared MCP”.
skillDisabledHint: This profile won't inject CC-Panes built-in Skills, profile Skills, or workspace project Skills.
skillCustomHint: Custom mode injects only the Skills selected below.
skillDefaultHint: The default set enables CC-Panes built-in Skills and profile Skills, and can add workspace project Skills.
externalSkillHint: Core mode passes the external pool by default; Custom mode only allows checked items.
userSkillLibraryHint: Skills installed into the user library. Check one to inject it into this launch profile; the Skill market can be enabled under Settings → Experimental.
noUserSkillLibrary: No skills in the user library yet.
skillMarketHint: Recommended Skills install to your user library. They inject into this profile only after being installed and checked.
noMarketEntries: No recommendations available. Existing profiles are unaffected when offline or the official index is unavailable.
installTitle: Install to the user library and enable for this profile
installBlockedTitle: Missing license, contentUrl, or sha256; can't install yet
profileSkillHint: Saved in this profile and injected via CC-Panes session context at launch; not written to your project.
profileSkillDescPlaceholder: Work habits or role requirements to append when entering a session
profileSkillContentPlaceholder: Write the full instructions for this profile Skill.
projectSkillWorkspaceHint: Project Skills are written to the project's .claude/commands and included in previews for the current workspace.
projectSkillSelectHint: Select a workspace on the left to add or edit project Skills here.

mcpProfileHint.stdioOnly: This CLI only consumes stdio servers: HTTP/SSE entries are skipped, shared MCP is injected with its original stdio command, and CC-Panes MCP goes through a local proxy.
mcpProfileHint.projectFile: This CLI has no per-launch MCP flag, so CC-Panes writes its servers into the project's own config file. Sessions in the same project share that file; it is excluded from git and cleaned up when the last session ends.
mcpProfileHint.noRemoteHeaders: Remote MCP servers that need request headers cannot reach this CLI.

mcpIsolationGap.declareOnly: This CLI cannot block MCP servers from its own config: it only receives the servers this profile selects, but anything already in its user or project config still loads.
mcpIsolationGap.none: This CLI ignores the profile's MCP selection: servers from its own config still load.

mcpRuntimeNote.sshNone: SSH sessions run the bare CLI on the remote machine: no MCP (CC-Panes, shared or workspace) reaches it.
mcpRuntimeNote.wslNone: This CLI gets no MCP injection inside WSL.
mcpRuntimeNote.wslPartial: Inside WSL only HTTP servers reach this CLI: workspace stdio entries are host commands, and remote servers go without request headers or SSE.

endpoints.hint: Each CLI uses a different endpoint: Claude uses Anthropic, Codex uses Responses (or Chat), Kimi / Grok use Chat, Gemini uses Gemini. Empty endpoints are not injected; the CLI falls back to its own default.

section.accountsHint: Accounts answer "who am I": one provider can hold several keys or several CLI logins. The default account is used when none is chosen.
section.envHint: Custom variables injected at launch; they win over generated variables with the same name. Sensitive values are not shown again after saving.
section.afterSaveHint: After saving, edit the provider to add more accounts (more keys, CLI logins) and preview what gets injected at launch.

nativeConfig.sectionHint: Extra launch settings in the CLI's own format (TOML for Codex, JSON for Claude). Merge order: the CLI's own config ← relay fragment ← profile fragment ← CC-Panes fields (model, reasoning effort, YOLO, routing, MCP). The CLI's global config file is never rewritten.
nativeConfig.providerHint: A native CLI config fragment for this relay. Every profile using it gets these settings; the same key in a profile wins. Routing, MCP, hooks and projects are managed by CC-Panes. Keep secrets in the keychain or environment variables.

formatHint.codex: Codex fragments are TOML, flattened into -c flags at launch. Tables merge key by key; arrays replace whole. model_provider, model_providers, projects, hooks, mcp_servers and secret-like keys are not allowed.
formatHint.claude: Claude fragments are JSON, merged into this session's --settings. Objects merge key by key. env cannot set routing or auth variables (ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, …) or secret-like keys.

issue.forbiddenKey: "{{key}}" is managed by CC-Panes (routing / auth / MCP / hooks / projects) and can't be overridden
issue.secretKey: "{{key}}" looks like a secret. Keep secrets in the keychain or environment variables
issue.notAnObject: A Claude fragment must be a JSON object

nativeConfig.previewEmpty: No extra native config. The CLI uses its own configuration.

runtimeNote.claudeSettingsLocalOnly: Claude fragments are injected via --settings, which currently applies only to local sessions.

purity.title: Channel purity
purity.intro: Checks every configured model of this provider for prompt injection, wrapped identities and model substitution. The check calls the models for real (3–4 requests per model) and costs a little.
purity.disclaimer: These checks can only find problems, not prove there are none: "No issues found" is not a guarantee.

finding.hidden_prefix: An empty request used {{detail}} input tokens: the upstream adds a hidden prompt before yours
finding.echoed_injection: Echoed a system prompt you didn't write
finding.echoed_something: Echoed some context; review it yourself
finding.fishing_admitted: Admitted a Kiro identity in its system prompt: wrapped channel
finding.fishing_unclear: Mentioned Kiro; can't tell whether it admitted or denied
finding.oauth_channel: Rejected new parameters with errors typical of resold Claude Code subscriptions
finding.new_params_rejected: Doesn't support new parameters (old proxy or translating gateway); doesn't affect the verdict
finding.nonstandard_fields: Response has fields the official API doesn't: {{detail}}
finding.self_report_mismatch: Self-reported model differs from the requested one (one model alone isn't conclusive)
finding.batch_downgrade: Every model's self-report mismatches ({{detail}}): models are being substituted
finding.response_model_mismatch: Response model is from a different family: {{detail}}

error.PURITY_BUSY: A check is already running; try again when it finishes
error.PURITY_UNSUPPORTED_TYPE: This provider type can't be checked yet
error.PURITY_LOGIN_ACCOUNT: Login accounts use the official subscription; nothing to check
error.PURITY_NO_KEY: The default account has no key
error.PURITY_NO_MODELS: No models to test: add models to the provider
error.PURITY_DISABLED: Channel purity checks are off: turn them on in Settings → Privacy
